decisions.reason: Mark sets "the Lord" in 5:19 beside "Jesus" here without comment. The reader is left to see that God's work is done through Jesus.

decisions.choice: the area called the Ten Towns, the Decapolis
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name.

decisions.choice: "Đê-ca-bô-lơ"; Readable adds "vùng Mười Thành"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliteration of the Greek name. Readable explains it with the plain "Mười Thành" (Ten Towns), as the English Readable does; the Sino-Vietnamese "Thập Thành" would be harder for new readers.

decisions.choice: "데가볼리" (L, B); "'열 도시'라는 뜻의 데가볼리 지방" (R)
decisions.reason: "데가볼리" is the established Protestant form (style guide, section 5). Readable gives the meaning of the name, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la región de las Diez Ciudades, llamada la Decápolis
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable explains the name, a league of ten Greek cities (meaning decision).

source.text: Καὶ διαπεράσαντος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ πάλιν εἰς τὸ πέραν συνήχθη ὄχλος πολὺς ἐπ’ αὐτόν, καὶ ἦν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν.

records.literal_gloss: And having crossed over the Jesus in the boat again to the other side, was gathered a crowd great to him, and he was beside the sea.

en.L: And when Jesus had crossed over again in the boat to the other side, a great crowd gathered around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was beside the sea.
en.B: When Jesus had gone back across by boat, a large crowd gathered around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still by the lake.
en.R: Jesus went back across Lake Galilee in the boat. A big crowd came together around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stood on the shore.

vi.L: Và khi Đức Giê-xu đã đi thuyền qua lại bờ bên kia, một đoàn dân đông nhóm lại quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ở bên bờ biển.
vi.B: Khi Đức Giê-xu đã đi thuyền trở lại bờ bên kia, một đoàn dân rất đông tụ họp quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn ở bên bờ biển.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đi thuyền trở về bờ bên kia hồ. Một đám đông rất lớn kéo đến vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ở trên bờ.

ko.L: 그리고 예수께서 배를 타고 다시 건너편으로 건너가시자, 큰 무리가 그분께로 모여들었다. 그리고 그분은 바닷가에 계셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 배를 타고 다시 건너편으로 건너가시자, 큰 무리가 예수께 모여들었다. 그때 예수께서는 아직 바닷가에 계셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 배를 타고 다시 갈릴리 호수 건너편으로 가셨다. 예수께서 호숫가에 계실 때, 많은 사람들이 예수 둘레로 모여들었다.

es.L: Y habiendo cruzado Jesús otra vez en la barca a la otra orilla, se reunió una gran multitud alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; y estaba junto al mar.
es.B: Cuando Jesús volvió a cruzar en la barca a la otra orilla, una gran multitud se reunió alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mientras aún estaba junto al mar.
es.R: Jesús volvió a cruzar el lago en la barca. Mientras estaba en la orilla, mucha gente se juntó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor.

fr.L: Et Jésus ayant de nouveau traversé dans la barque vers l’autre rive, une foule nombreuse se rassembla auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était au bord de la mer.
fr.B: Quand Jésus eut regagné l’autre rive en barque, une grande foule se rassembla autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, alors qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était encore au bord de la mer.
fr.R: Jésus a retraversé le lac de Galilée en barque. Une grande foule s’est rassemblée autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, sur le rivage.

sw.L: Na Yesu alipokwisha kuvuka tena kwa mashua mpaka ng'ambo, umati mkubwa ulikusanyika {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} alikuwa kando ya bahari.
sw.B: Yesu alipokwisha kuvuka tena kwa mashua mpaka ng'ambo ya pili, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikusanyika {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} alipokuwa bado kando ya bahari.
sw.R: Yesu alivuka tena Ziwa Galilaya kwa mashua. Alipokuwa ufuoni, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikusanyika kumzunguka.

decisions.choice: to the other side: back to the western, Jewish shore
decisions.reason: Jesus returns to Galilee, where the crowds wait for him (4:1).

decisions.choice: in the boat, as the SBLGNT reads
decisions.reason: A few early manuscripts lack "in the boat". The sense is the same either way. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: on the shore
decisions.reason: Readable calls the lakeside the shore.

source.text: καὶ ἔρχεται εἷς τῶν ἀρχισυναγώγων, ὀνόματι Ἰάϊρος, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν πίπτει πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ παρακαλεῖ αὐτὸν πολλὰ λέγων ὅτι Τὸ θυγάτριόν μου ἐσχάτως ἔχει, ἵνα ἐλθὼν ἐπιθῇς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῇ ἵνα σωθῇ καὶ ζήσῃ.

records.literal_gloss: And comes one of the synagogue leaders, by name Jairus, and having seen him falls at the feet of him \v 23 and begs him much saying that, The little daughter of me at the end is holding, that having come you would lay the hands on her so that she may be saved and live.

en.L: And one of the synagogue leaders, Jairus by name, comes, and seeing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} he falls at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet \v 23 and begs {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} earnestly, saying, "My little daughter is at the point of death. [I beg {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come and lay [{{deity_pronoun:your|Your}}] hands on her, so that she may be saved and live."
en.B: One of the leaders of the synagogue, a man named Jairus, came up. When he saw Jesus, he threw himself at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet \v 23 and pleaded with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} again and again. "My little daughter is dying," he said. "Please come and put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands on her, so that she may get well and live."
en.R: A man named Jairus came. He was one of the leaders of the local synagogue. When Jairus saw Jesus, he bowed down at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \v 23 He begged Jesus over and over, "My little girl is about to die. Please come and put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands on her. Then she will get well and live!"

vi.L: Và một trong những người lãnh đạo nhà hội, tên là Giai-ru, đến, và khi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ông sấp mình dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 23 và tha thiết nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Con gái nhỏ của tôi sắp chết rồi. [Xin] Thầy đến đặt tay trên cháu, để cháu được cứu và được sống."
vi.B: Có một người lãnh đạo nhà hội tên là Giai-ru đến. Vừa thấy Đức Giê-xu, ông liền sấp mình dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 23 và tha thiết nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi: "Con gái nhỏ của tôi sắp chết. Xin Thầy đến đặt tay trên cháu để cháu được lành bệnh và được sống."
vi.R: Một người tên là Giai-ru đến. Ông là một trong những người lãnh đạo nhà hội ở địa phương. Khi thấy Đức Giê-xu, Giai-ru quỳ xuống dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 23 Ông cứ nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi: "Con gái nhỏ của tôi sắp chết. Xin Thầy đến đặt tay trên cháu. Như vậy cháu sẽ khỏi bệnh và được sống!"

ko.L: 그리고 회당장들 가운데 하나인, 이름이 야이로라는 사람이 온다. 그리고 그분을 보고 그분의 발 앞에 엎드린다. \v 23 그리고 그분께 간곡히 간청하며 말한다. "제 어린 딸이 죽게 되었습니다. 오셔서 그 아이에게 손을 얹어 주십시오. 그래서 그 아이가 구원을 받고 살게 해 주십시오."
ko.B: 회당장 가운데 한 사람인 야이로가 와서 예수를 보고 그 발 앞에 엎드렸다. \v 23 그리고 거듭 간청했다. "제 어린 딸이 죽어 갑니다. 오셔서 그 아이에게 손을 얹어 주십시오. 그러면 그 아이가 나아서 살 것입니다."
ko.R: 야이로라는 사람이 왔다. 그는 그 고장 회당을 이끄는 지도자 가운데 한 사람이었다. 야이로는 예수를 보자 그 발 앞에 엎드렸다. \v 23 그리고 예수께 몇 번이나 간청했다. "제 어린 딸이 곧 죽을 것 같습니다. 제발 오셔서 그 아이에게 손을 얹어 주십시오. 그러면 그 아이가 나아서 살 것입니다!"

es.L: Y viene uno de los jefes de la sinagoga, de nombre Jairo, y al verlo cae a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies \v 23 y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ruega mucho, diciendo: «Mi hijita está en las últimas; [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego] que vengas y pongas las manos sobre ella, para que se salve y viva».
es.B: Llegó uno de los jefes de la sinagoga, un hombre llamado Jairo. Al ver a Jesús, se echó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies \v 23 y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suplicó con insistencia: «Mi hijita se está muriendo. Ven, por favor, y pon las manos sobre ella para que se sane y viva».
es.R: Llegó un hombre llamado Jairo. Era uno de los jefes de la sinagoga de aquel lugar. Cuando vio a Jesús, se arrodilló a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies. \v 23 Le rogó una y otra vez: «Mi niña se está muriendo. Por favor, ven y pon {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos sobre ella. ¡Así se sanará y vivirá!».

fr.L: Et vient un des chefs de la synagogue, nommé Jaïre, et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voyant, il tombe à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds \v 23 et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplie instamment, disant : « Ma petite fille est à toute extrémité. [Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prie] que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viennes poser les mains sur elle, afin qu’elle soit sauvée et qu’elle vive. »
fr.B: Arriva l’un des chefs de la synagogue, un homme nommé Jaïre. Dès qu’il vit Jésus, il se jeta à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds \v 23 et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplia avec insistance : « Ma petite fille va mourir, dit-il. Viens, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, pose {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains sur elle, pour qu’elle guérisse et qu’elle vive. »
fr.R: Un homme appelé Jaïre est arrivé. C’était un des chefs de la synagogue de l’endroit. Quand Jaïre a vu Jésus, il s’est mis à genoux à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \v 23 Il a supplié Jésus encore et encore : « Ma petite fille va bientôt mourir. Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, viens poser {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains sur elle. Alors elle guérira et elle vivra ! »

sw.L: Na anakuja mmoja wa wakuu wa sinagogi, jina lake Yairo, naye akimwona anaanguka miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} \v 23 na anamsihi sana, akisema, "Binti yangu mdogo yu katika hali ya kufa; [nakusihi] uje uweke mikono [{{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}] juu yake, ili aokolewe na aishi."
sw.B: Mmoja wa wakuu wa sinagogi, mtu aitwaye Yairo, alifika. Alipomwona Yesu, alijitupa miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} \v 23 akamsihi tena na tena, "Binti yangu mdogo anakaribia kufa. Tafadhali njoo uweke mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu yake, ili apone na aishi."
sw.R: Mtu mmoja aitwaye Yairo alikuja. Yeye alikuwa mmoja wa viongozi wa sinagogi la mji ule. Yairo alipomwona Yesu, alipiga magoti miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}. \v 23 Akamsihi Yesu tena na tena, "Binti yangu mdogo yuko karibu kufa. Tafadhali njoo uweke mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu yake. Hapo atapona na kuishi!"

decisions.choice: synagogue leader: the man in charge of the synagogue's meetings
decisions.reason: A synagogue leader arranged worship and chose who would read and teach. He was a respected man in the town.

decisions.choice: is holding at the end: is at the point of death
decisions.reason: The phrase means near the end of life. She is still alive (5:35).

decisions.choice: be saved: be made well, rescued from death
decisions.reason: The verb is used both for healing and for God's saving. Here it means rescued from her illness, set beside "live"; the wider sense may be heard too.

decisions.choice: that you would come and lay: an urgent request without a main verb
decisions.reason: The clause stands on its own as a plea. "I beg you" is understood.

decisions.choice: lay hands on her: touch to heal and bless
decisions.reason: Laying on of hands was a sign of blessing and was expected from a healer (6:5; 8:23).

decisions.choice: get well
decisions.reason: In a request for a sick child, Balanced and Readable use the healing sense. Literal keeps the word that can also mean salvation.

decisions.choice: one of the leaders of the local synagogue
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that he led a local meeting place.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo nhà hội"
decisions.reason: The man in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision). "Nhà hội" is the settled word for synagogue; "người lãnh đạo" is plain modern Vietnamese, where "cai" is old and "hội đường" is the Catholic word.

decisions.choice: Jairus says "Thầy" to Jesus, and "cháu" for his daughter
decisions.reason: Jairus comes to Jesus as to a respected teacher, so he calls him "Thầy" (style guide, section 6). Speaking to a respected person, a Vietnamese parent calls his own child "cháu"; "nó" would sound careless. "Xin" is the polite word a request requires, bracketed at Literal because the Greek has no verb of asking here (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "회당장" (L, B); "회당을 이끄는 지도자" (R); "야이로"
decisions.reason: "회당장" is the established Korean word for the man in charge of a synagogue's meetings; Readable describes him. "야이로" is the Protestant form of the name.

decisions.choice: "구원을 받다" (L); "낫다" (B, R) for sozo, through chapter 5 (5:23, 5:28, 5:34)
decisions.reason: The verb means both rescue from death and being made well (meaning decisions). Literal keeps "구원" so the link with salvation shows; Balanced and Readable say "낫다", and at 5:34 keep "구원하다" beside it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: se salve (L); se sane (B); se sanará (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means both "be saved" and "be made well" (meaning decision). Literal keeps "salvarse", which can carry both; Balanced and Readable say she will get well, as the English does.

decisions.choice: jefe de la sinagoga
decisions.reason: The man in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision); "jefe" is the plain Spanish for this office.

decisions.choice: un des chefs de la synagogue
decisions.reason: The man who led the synagogue’s meetings (meaning decision m1). "Chef de la synagogue" is plain and widely understood; the same words are used through 5:35-38.

decisions.choice: mkuu wa sinagogi (L, B); kiongozi wa sinagogi (R)
decisions.reason: "Mkuu wa sinagogi" names the office of the man in charge of the meetings; Readable says "kiongozi" (leader), the everyday word. "Sinagogi" is the word used in the Swahili of John.

decisions.choice: Yairo
decisions.reason: The name in its usual Swahili form, with Y- for the Greek I- as in "Yesu", "Yakobo" and "Yohana".

source.text: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And he went with him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went with him.
en.B: So Jesus set out with him.
en.R: So Jesus went with Jairus.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi với ông ấy.
vi.B: Vậy Đức Giê-xu đi với ông.
vi.R: Vậy Đức Giê-xu đi với Giai-ru.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그와 함께 떠나가셨다.
ko.B: 그래서 예수께서 그와 함께 나서셨다.
ko.R: 그래서 예수께서 야이로와 함께 가셨다.

es.L: Y se fue con él.
es.B: Jesús se fue con él.
es.R: Entonces Jesús se fue con Jairo.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’en alla avec lui.
fr.B: Jésus partit donc avec lui.
fr.R: Alors Jésus est parti avec Jaïre.

sw.L: Naye akaenda pamoja naye.
sw.B: Basi Yesu akaondoka pamoja naye.
sw.R: Basi Yesu akaenda pamoja na Yairo.

decisions.choice: him: Jairus
decisions.reason: Jesus goes with the father to his house.

source.text: Καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, καὶ συνέθλιβον αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And was following him a crowd great, and were pressing around him.

en.L: And a great crowd was following {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and they were pressing around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: A huge crowd went along behind {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, jostling {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on every side.
en.R: A big crowd followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. People were pushing against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from all sides.

vi.L: Và một đoàn dân đông đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ chen lấn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Một đoàn dân rất đông đi theo sau, chen lấn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ mọi phía.
vi.R: Rất đông người đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ chen lấn, xô đẩy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ mọi phía.

ko.L: 그리고 큰 무리가 그분을 따르고 있었고, 그분을 에워싸 밀어 대고 있었다.
ko.B: 많은 무리가 예수를 따라가며 사방에서 밀어 댔다.
ko.R: 많은 사람들이 예수를 따라갔다. 사람들이 사방에서 예수를 밀어 댔다.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía una gran multitud, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} apretujaban.
es.B: Una gran multitud {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} apretujaban por todos lados.
es.R: Mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía. Lo empujaban por todos lados.

fr.L: Et une foule nombreuse {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait, et ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pressaient.
fr.B: Une foule immense {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} serrait de tous côtés.
fr.R: Une grande foule {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a suivi. Les gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} bousculaient de tous les côtés.

sw.L: Na umati mkubwa ulikuwa ukimfuata, nao walikuwa wakimsonga.
sw.B: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata, ukimsonga kila upande.
sw.R: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata. Watu walikuwa wakimsukuma kutoka kila upande.

decisions.choice: pressing around: crushing in on him
decisions.reason: The verb means to press hard from all sides. It explains the disciples' answer in 5:31.

source.text: καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος δώδεκα ἔτη καὶ πολλὰ παθοῦσα ὑπὸ πολλῶν ἰατρῶν καὶ δαπανήσασα τὰ παρ’ αὐτῆς πάντα καὶ μηδὲν ὠφεληθεῖσα ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εἰς τὸ χεῖρον ἐλθοῦσα, ἀκούσασα περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐλθοῦσα ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: And a woman being with a flow of blood twelve years \v 26 and many [things] having suffered under many physicians and having spent the from her all and nothing having benefited but rather to the worse having come, \v 27 having heard concerning the Jesus, having come in the crowd behind, touched the garment of him.

en.L: And a woman who had had a flow of blood [for] twelve years, \v 26 and had suffered much under many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and had not benefited at all but rather had grown worse, \v 27 having heard about Jesus, came up in the crowd behind [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] and touched {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} garment.
en.B: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. \v 26 She had gone through a great deal at the hands of many doctors and had spent everything she owned. Instead of getting better, she had only grown worse. \v 27 She had heard about Jesus, so she made her way through the crowd and touched {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cloak from behind.
en.R: A woman was there who had been sick with bleeding for twelve years. \v 26 Many doctors had tried to help her, and they had caused her a lot of pain. She had spent all her money on them. But she was not getting better. She was getting worse. \v 27 This woman had heard about Jesus. So she pushed through the crowd and touched {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coat from behind.

vi.L: Và một người phụ nữ bị ra huyết đã mười hai năm, \v 26 đã chịu khổ nhiều vì nhiều thầy thuốc, đã tiêu hết mọi thứ mình có mà chẳng được ích gì, trái lại càng thêm nặng, \v 27 khi nghe nói về Đức Giê-xu, thì đến phía sau [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] trong đoàn dân và chạm vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong đám đông có một người phụ nữ bị bệnh rong huyết đã mười hai năm. \v 26 Bà đã chịu nhiều đau đớn trong tay nhiều thầy thuốc và đã tiêu hết tài sản mình có. Thế nhưng bệnh không đỡ chút nào, trái lại càng nặng thêm. \v 27 Nghe nói về Đức Giê-xu, bà len vào đám đông, đến phía sau và chạm vào áo choàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ở đó có một người phụ nữ bị bệnh ra máu suốt mười hai năm. \v 26 Nhiều thầy thuốc đã tìm cách chữa cho bà, nhưng họ chỉ làm bà đau đớn thêm. Bà đã tiêu hết tiền của vào việc chữa bệnh. Thế mà bệnh không bớt, lại còn nặng hơn. \v 27 Bà đã nghe nói về Đức Giê-xu. Vì vậy, bà chen qua đám đông và chạm vào áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ phía sau.

ko.L: 그리고 한 여자가 열두 해 동안 피가 흐르는 [병을] 앓고 있었고, \v 26 많은 의사들에게 많은 고통을 겪었으며, 자기에게 있던 것을 다 써 버렸으나 아무 도움도 얻지 못하고 오히려 더 나빠졌는데, \v 27 예수에 관하여 듣고, 무리 속에서 뒤로 와서 그분의 겉옷을 만졌다.
ko.B: 무리 가운데 열두 해 동안 하혈하는 병을 앓아 온 여자가 있었다. \v 26 그 여자는 여러 의사에게 치료를 받으면서 고생만 많이 했고, 가진 재산도 다 써 버렸다. 그런데도 낫기는커녕 오히려 더 나빠지기만 했다. \v 27 그 여자는 예수의 소문을 듣고, 무리 사이로 들어가 뒤에서 예수의 겉옷을 만졌다.
ko.R: 그곳에 열두 해 동안 피가 멈추지 않는 병을 앓아 온 여자가 있었다. \v 26 여러 의사가 그 여자를 고쳐 보려고 했지만, 오히려 큰 고통만 주었다. 여자는 가진 돈을 의사들에게 다 써 버렸다. 그런데도 병이 낫지 않고 점점 더 나빠졌다. \v 27 이 여자는 예수에 대한 이야기를 들었다. 그래서 사람들 사이를 비집고 들어가 뒤에서 예수의 겉옷을 만졌다.

es.L: Y una mujer que padecía flujo de sangre [desde hacía] doce años, \v 26 y que había sufrido mucho a manos de muchos médicos, y había gastado todo lo que tenía, y de nada le había servido, sino que más bien había ido a peor, \v 27 habiendo oído hablar de Jesús, vino por detrás entre la multitud y tocó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} manto.
es.B: Había entre la gente una mujer que llevaba doce años con hemorragias. \v 26 Había sufrido mucho a manos de muchos médicos y había gastado todo lo que tenía. En lugar de mejorar, iba de mal en peor. \v 27 Cuando oyó hablar de Jesús, se abrió paso entre la multitud y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tocó el manto por detrás.
es.R: Allí había una mujer que llevaba doce años enferma con hemorragias. \v 26 Muchos médicos habían tratado de curarla, y le habían hecho sufrir mucho. Había gastado en ellos todo su dinero. Pero no mejoraba. Al contrario, cada vez estaba peor. \v 27 Esta mujer había oído hablar de Jesús. Así que se abrió paso entre la gente y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tocó el manto por detrás.

fr.L: Et une femme qui avait une perte de sang depuis douze ans, \v 26 qui avait beaucoup souffert entre les mains de nombreux médecins, qui avait dépensé tout ce qu’elle possédait et n’en avait tiré aucun profit, mais était plutôt allée de mal en pis, \v 27 ayant entendu parler de Jésus, vint dans la foule par derrière et toucha {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vêtement.
fr.B: Il y avait dans la foule une femme qui souffrait de pertes de sang depuis douze ans. \v 26 Elle avait beaucoup souffert entre les mains de nombreux médecins et avait dépensé tout ce qu’elle possédait. Au lieu d’aller mieux, son état n’avait fait qu’empirer. \v 27 Elle avait entendu parler de Jésus ; elle se glissa donc dans la foule et, par derrière, toucha {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} manteau.
fr.R: Il y avait là une femme malade : depuis douze ans, elle perdait du sang. \v 26 Beaucoup de médecins avaient essayé de la soigner, et ils l’avaient fait beaucoup souffrir. Elle avait dépensé tout son argent pour eux. Mais elle n’allait pas mieux. Elle allait de plus en plus mal. \v 27 Cette femme avait entendu parler de Jésus. Alors elle s’est faufilée dans la foule et elle a touché {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} manteau par derrière.

sw.L: Na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa akitokwa na damu [kwa] miaka kumi na miwili, \v 26 na aliyekuwa ameteseka sana chini ya matabibu wengi, na kutumia vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, wala hakufaidika kitu bali alizidi kuwa mbaya, \v 27 aliposikia habari za Yesu, alikuja katika umati kwa nyuma [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}], akaligusa vazi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Katika umati ule alikuwamo mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa akitokwa na damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili. \v 26 Alikuwa ameteseka sana mikononi mwa matabibu wengi, na alikuwa ametumia mali yake yote. Badala ya kupata nafuu, hali yake ilizidi kuwa mbaya. \v 27 Alikuwa amesikia habari za Yesu, kwa hiyo alipenya katikati ya umati, akaligusa vazi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa nyuma.
sw.R: Palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa mgonjwa wa kutokwa na damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili. \v 26 Madaktari wengi walijaribu kumsaidia, nao walimsababishia maumivu mengi. Alikuwa ametumia fedha zake zote kuwalipa. Lakini hakupata nafuu, bali hali yake ilizidi kuwa mbaya. \v 27 Mwanamke huyu alikuwa amesikia habari za Yesu. Kwa hiyo alipenya katikati ya umati, akaligusa vazi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa nyuma.

decisions.choice: a flow of blood: continual bleeding, most likely from the womb
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used in Leviticus 15:25 for a woman's bleeding outside her monthly period.

decisions.choice: a flow of blood: in the law of Moses it made her unclean
decisions.reason: Under Leviticus 15:25-27 she was unclean all those years, and so was anything she touched. That is why she came from behind in secret.

decisions.choice: one long sentence of participles leading to she touched
decisions.reason: Mark piles up seven participles describing her story before the one main verb, touched.

decisions.choice: suffered much under many physicians: the treatments themselves hurt her
decisions.reason: Medicine of the time could be painful. Mark notes that it cost her everything and did no good.

decisions.choice: garment: the outer cloak
decisions.reason: The word is used for the outer robe. Matthew 9:20 and Luke 8:44 say she touched its fringe.

decisions.choice: the sentence is broken into several
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the chain of participles into separate sentences.

decisions.choice: Many doctors had tried to help her, and they had caused her a lot of pain
alternatives: had suffered much under many physicians
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what suffering under doctors meant.

decisions.choice: "ra huyết" (L); "bệnh rong huyết" (B); "bệnh ra máu" (R)
decisions.reason: Continual bleeding, most likely from the womb (meaning decision). "Rong huyết" is the ordinary medical word for that; "băng huyết" is a sudden heavy bleed, not a twelve-year illness. Readable uses the plainest words.

decisions.choice: "bà" for the woman
decisions.reason: Vietnamese marks age in the pronoun. She has been ill for twelve years and has spent all she owned, so "bà", a respectful word for a grown woman, suits her better than "cô" (young woman).

decisions.choice: "피가 흐르는 [병을] 앓다" (L); "하혈하는 병" (B); "피가 멈추지 않는 병" (R)
decisions.reason: "혈루증" is the word of familiar versions and is not current Korean. "하혈" is the ordinary word for bleeding from the womb, which is most likely meant (meaning decision); Readable describes it.

decisions.choice: One sentence of connected clauses, ending "그분의 겉옷을 만졌다"
decisions.reason: The Greek is one sentence of participles leading to "she touched" (meaning decision). Korean cannot stack participles before the subject, so Literal joins the clauses with connective endings and keeps each verse's content after its marker.

decisions.choice: flujo de sangre (L); hemorragias (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek phrase; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Spanish word for continual bleeding (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: vêtement (L); manteau (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the outer cloak (meaning decision m5). Literal keeps the general "vêtement"; Balanced and Readable say "manteau". In 5:28-30 the plural, "his clothes", is "ses vêtements" at every level.

decisions.choice: matabibu (L, B); madaktari (R)
decisions.reason: "Tabibu" is the standard word for a physician; "mganga" also means a traditional healer or diviner, which would bring the wrong picture. Readable uses the everyday "daktari".

source.text: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὅτι Ἐὰν ἅψωμαι κἂν τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ σωθήσομαι.

records.literal_gloss: She was saying for that, If I touch even the garments of him, I will be saved.

en.L: For she was saying, "If I touch even {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} garments, I will be saved."
en.B: She kept telling herself, "Even if all I touch is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clothes, I will be made well."
en.R: She thought, "If I can only touch {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clothes, I will get well."

vi.L: Vì bà nói: "Nếu tôi chạm được dù chỉ áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ được cứu."
vi.B: Bà cứ tự nhủ: "Dù chỉ chạm được vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thôi, tôi cũng sẽ được lành."
vi.R: Bà nghĩ: "Chỉ cần chạm được vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ khỏi bệnh."

ko.L: 그 여자가 "내가 그분의 옷만이라도 만지면 구원을 받을 것이다" 하고 말하고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 "그분의 옷만 만져도 내가 나을 것이다" 하고 속으로 거듭 말했던 것이다.
ko.R: 여자는 "그분의 옷만 만질 수 있어도 나는 나을 것이다" 하고 생각했다.

es.L: Porque decía: «Si toco aunque sea {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} vestidos, me salvaré».
es.B: Porque se decía a sí misma: «Con solo tocar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ropa, quedaré sana».
es.R: Pensaba: «Si tan solo toco {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ropa, me sanaré».

fr.L: Car elle disait : « Si je touche ne serait-ce que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements, je serai sauvée. »
fr.B: Elle se disait en effet : « Si je touche seulement {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements, je serai guérie. »
fr.R: Elle pensait : « Si j’arrive à toucher seulement {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements, je vais guérir. »

sw.L: Kwa maana alikuwa akisema, "Nikigusa hata mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, nitaokolewa."
sw.B: Alikuwa akijiambia, "Hata nikigusa mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tu, nitapona."
sw.R: Alifikiri, "Nikiweza tu kugusa nguo {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, nitapona."

decisions.choice: she was saying: saying to herself
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: she kept saying this, most likely to herself.

decisions.choice: I will be saved: I will be made well
decisions.reason: As in 5:23, the verb means rescue from her illness; Jesus' reply in 5:34 uses the same verb and lets its wider sense be heard.

decisions.choice: even: even his clothes, if not himself
decisions.reason: The word means "even" or "if only". She dares not ask him directly.

decisions.choice: be made well (B); get well (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the healing sense, which is what she has in mind.

decisions.choice: me salvaré (L); quedaré sana (B); me sanaré (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 5:23, with both senses (meaning decision); the levels render it as there.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξηράνθη ἡ πηγὴ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς, καὶ ἔγνω τῷ σώματι ὅτι ἴαται ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγος.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately was dried up the source of the blood of her, and she knew in the body that she has been healed from the affliction.

en.L: And immediately the source of her blood was dried up, and she knew in [her] body that she had been healed of the affliction.
en.B: At once her bleeding stopped, and she could feel in her body that she was free of her suffering.
en.R: Right away her bleeding stopped. She could feel in her body that she was healed.

vi.L: Và lập tức nguồn máu của bà khô cạn, và bà biết trong thân thể mình rằng bà đã được chữa lành khỏi tai họa ấy.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy máu cầm lại, và bà cảm nhận trong thân thể mình rằng bà đã khỏi bệnh khổ.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức, máu cầm lại. Bà cảm thấy trong người mình đã được lành bệnh.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 그 여자의 피의 근원이 말라 버렸고, 그 여자는 자기가 그 괴로운 병에서 나았다는 것을 몸으로 알았다.
ko.B: 곧바로 피가 멎었다. 그 여자는 괴롭던 병이 나은 것을 몸으로 느낄 수 있었다.
ko.R: 바로 그 순간 피가 멈추었다. 여자는 병이 나은 것을 몸으로 느낄 수 있었다.

es.L: Y enseguida se secó la fuente de su sangre, y sintió en el cuerpo que había quedado sana de su mal.
es.B: Al instante dejó de sangrar, y sintió en su cuerpo que estaba libre de su sufrimiento.
es.R: Enseguida dejó de sangrar. Sintió en su cuerpo que estaba sana.

fr.L: Et aussitôt la source de son sang fut tarie, et elle sut dans [son] corps qu’elle était guérie de son mal.
fr.B: À l’instant même, son hémorragie s’arrêta, et elle sentit dans son corps qu’elle était délivrée de son mal.
fr.R: Tout de suite, elle a arrêté de saigner. Elle a senti dans son corps qu’elle était guérie.

sw.L: Na mara moja chemchemi ya damu yake ikakauka, naye akatambua mwilini [mwake] kwamba ameponywa adha [yake].
sw.B: Mara moja damu yake ikaacha kutoka, naye akasikia mwilini mwake kwamba ameponywa mateso yake.
sw.R: Mara hiyo damu yake ikaacha kutoka. Aliweza kusikia mwilini mwake kwamba amepona.

decisions.choice: source: the place the bleeding came from
decisions.reason: The word means a spring or fountain. Leviticus 12:7 uses it for a woman's bleeding.

decisions.choice: affliction: a disease, literally a whip or scourge
decisions.reason: The word means a whip, and was used for a painful illness (3:10). It does not say the illness was a punishment.

decisions.choice: she knew: she could feel it
decisions.reason: She is certain from what she feels in her body.

decisions.choice: "괴로운 병" (L, B) for mastix; no picture of a whip
decisions.reason: The word is literally a whip (meaning decision), as at Mark 3:10, where the Korean also gives the sense rather than the picture; "괴로운 병" says a painful affliction, and Readable simply says "병".

decisions.choice: su mal
decisions.reason: The Greek word is literally a whip or scourge, used for a disease (meaning decision). Spanish "azote" would puzzle readers here, so Literal says "mal"; Balanced has "sufrimiento", as the English does.

decisions.choice: son mal
decisions.reason: The Greek word is literally a whip or scourge, used for a disease (meaning decision m2). French "fléau" would sound like a public calamity and "affliction" like grief, so both levels say "son mal"; 5:34 uses the same word.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπιγνοὺς ἐν ἑαυτῷ τὴν ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν ἐξελθοῦσαν ἐπιστραφεὶς ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ἔλεγεν· Τίς μου ἥψατο τῶν ἱματίων;

records.literal_gloss: And immediately the Jesus having known in himself the out of him power having gone out, having turned around in the crowd he was saying, Who of me touched the garments?

en.L: And immediately Jesus, knowing in {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} that power had gone out from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, turned around in the crowd and was saying, "Who touched {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} garments?"
en.B: Right away Jesus knew within {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} that power had gone out of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He turned around in the crowd and said, "Who touched {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} clothes?"
en.R: At that moment Jesus knew that power had gone out from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} turned to face the people and asked, "Who touched {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} clothes?"

vi.L: Và lập tức Đức Giê-xu, tự biết trong mình rằng quyền năng đã ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì quay lại giữa đoàn dân và hỏi: "Ai đã chạm vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"
vi.B: Ngay lúc đó Đức Giê-xu biết trong mình rằng có quyền năng đã ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài quay lại giữa đám đông và hỏi: "Ai đã chạm vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"
vi.R: Ngay lúc ấy, Đức Giê-xu biết có quyền năng đã ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay lại nhìn đám đông và hỏi: "Ai đã chạm vào áo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"

ko.L: 그리고 곧 예수께서는 자기에게서 능력이 나간 것을 스스로 아시고, 무리 가운데서 돌아서서 말씀하셨다. "누가 내 옷을 만졌느냐?"
ko.B: 곧바로 예수께서는 자기에게서 능력이 나간 것을 속으로 아셨다. 그래서 무리 가운데서 돌아서서 말씀하셨다. "누가 내 옷을 만졌느냐?"
ko.R: 바로 그때 예수께서는 자기에게서 능력이 나간 것을 아셨다. 그래서 사람들 쪽으로 돌아서서 물으셨다. "누가 내 옷을 만졌느냐?"

es.L: Y enseguida Jesús, conociendo en {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo que había salido de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} poder, volviéndose en medio de la multitud, decía: «¿Quién tocó {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} vestidos?».
es.B: Al instante Jesús notó dentro de {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} que había salido poder de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Se volvió hacia la multitud y preguntó: «¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha tocado la ropa?».
es.R: En ese momento Jesús supo que había salido poder de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces se volvió hacia la gente y preguntó: «¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó la ropa?».

fr.L: Et aussitôt Jésus, connaissant en {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} la puissance sortie de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, se retourna dans la foule et disait : « Qui a touché {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} vêtements ? »
fr.B: Aussitôt Jésus sut en {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qu’une puissance était sortie de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il se retourna au milieu de la foule et demanda : « Qui a touché {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} vêtements ? »
fr.R: Au même moment, Jésus a senti qu’une puissance était sortie de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est tourné vers les gens et a demandé : « Qui a touché {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} vêtements ? »

sw.L: Na mara moja Yesu, akitambua ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwamba nguvu imetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, aligeuka katika umati, akawa akisema, "Ni nani aliyegusa mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}?"
sw.B: Mara moja Yesu alitambua ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwamba nguvu imetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Akageuka katikati ya umati, akauliza, "Ni nani aliyegusa mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}?"
sw.R: Wakati huo huo Yesu alitambua kwamba nguvu imetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Kwa hiyo akageuka kuwatazama watu, akauliza, "Ni nani aliyegusa nguo {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}?"

decisions.choice: power: the power to heal
decisions.reason: The word is the one Mark uses for miracles (6:2, 5). Healing power went out from Jesus.

decisions.choice: knowing in himself: he was aware of it within
decisions.reason: Jesus knew at once, without being told.

decisions.choice: who touched my garments: Jesus asks in order to meet her
alternatives: Jesus did not know who it was
decisions.reason: Mark does not explain whether Jesus knew. His question brings the woman forward to be seen and spoken to (5:33-34).

decisions.choice: "trong mình" for "in himself", with no setting span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese says "in himself" with the reflexive "mình", which is not a personal pronoun and so takes no deity_pronoun span, where the English has one.

source.text: καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Βλέπεις τὸν ὄχλον συνθλίβοντά σε, καὶ λέγεις· Τίς μου ἥψατο;

records.literal_gloss: And were saying to him the disciples of him, You see the crowd pressing around you, and you say, Who of me touched?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples were saying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You see the crowd pressing around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say, 'Who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?'"
en.B: His disciples said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You can see how the crowd is crushing in on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. How can {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} ask, 'Who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?'"
en.R: His followers said, "Look at all these people pushing against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! How can {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} ask, 'Who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?'"

vi.L: Và các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy thấy đoàn dân chen lấn Thầy, mà Thầy còn hỏi: 'Ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?'"
vi.B: Các môn đồ thưa: "Thầy thấy đó, dân chúng chen lấn Thầy như vậy, sao Thầy còn hỏi: 'Ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?'"
vi.R: Các môn đồ thưa: "Thầy xem, bao nhiêu người đang chen lấn Thầy! Sao Thầy lại hỏi: 'Ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?'"

ko.L: 그러자 그분의 제자들이 그분께 말하고 있었다. "선생님께서는 무리가 선생님을 에워싸고 밀어 대는 것을 보시면서도 '누가 나를 만졌느냐?' 하고 말씀하십니까?"
ko.B: 제자들이 예수께 말했다. "무리가 이렇게 선생님을 밀어 대는 것을 보시면서, 어떻게 '누가 나를 만졌느냐?' 하고 물으십니까?"
ko.R: 제자들이 말했다. "보십시오. 이 많은 사람들이 선생님을 밀어 대고 있습니다! 그런데 어떻게 '누가 나를 만졌느냐?' 하고 물으실 수 있습니까?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} decían: «Ves que la multitud {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} apretuja, y dices: “¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó?”».
es.B: Sus discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Ves que la multitud {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} apretuja por todos lados, ¿y preguntas quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ha tocado?».
es.R: Sus discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «¡Mira cuánta gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está empujando! ¿Cómo puedes preguntar quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tocó?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disaient : « Tu vois la foule qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} presse, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis : “Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ?” »
fr.B: Ses disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Tu vois bien que la foule {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}écrase de tous côtés. Comment peux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} demander : “Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ?” »
fr.R: Ses disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Regarde tous ces gens qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bousculent ! Comment peux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} demander : “Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ?” »

sw.L: Na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa wakimwambia, "Unaona umati unavyokusonga, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unasema, 'Ni nani aliyenigusa?'"
sw.B: Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakamwambia, "Unaona jinsi umati unavyokusonga. Unawezaje kuuliza, 'Ni nani aliyenigusa?'"
sw.R: Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakamwambia, "Tazama watu hawa wote wanavyokusukuma! Unawezaje kuuliza, 'Ni nani aliyenigusa?'"

decisions.choice: you see ... and you say: a reproachful question
decisions.reason: The disciples think the question makes no sense with so many people touching him.

decisions.choice: How can you ask
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the disciples' surprise plain.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" in the disciples' words
decisions.reason: The style guide's form of address for disciples speaking to Jesus. "Thầy" is a noun of address and takes no setting, where the English "you" has one; the words they quote from him keep Jesus's own "Ta".

decisions.choice: The disciples speak in 합쇼체 and say "선생님" for "you"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 3:32, Korean does not address a respected teacher as "you"; "선생님" stands for the pronoun, so Literal does not bracket it.

decisions.choice: ¿y preguntas quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ha tocado? (B); ¿Cómo puedes preguntar quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tocó? (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable report Jesus' question indirectly, which Spanish does more naturally than a quotation inside a question; the reproach (meaning decision) stays.

decisions.choice: ses disciples (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the French style guide keeps "disciples" at every level, a word French readers know, as the French John does. This holds throughout Mark 5.

source.text: καὶ περιεβλέπετο ἰδεῖν τὴν τοῦτο ποιήσασαν.

records.literal_gloss: And he was looking around to see the one this having done.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was looking around to see the [woman] who had done this.
en.B: But Jesus went on searching the faces around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for the one who had done it.
en.R: But Jesus kept looking at the people around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to find out who had touched {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứ nhìn quanh để thấy người [phụ nữ] đã làm điều này.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cứ đưa mắt nhìn quanh tìm người đã làm việc ấy.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cứ nhìn những người chung quanh để tìm xem ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 이 일을 한 [여자를] 보시려고 둘러보고 계셨다.
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서는 이 일을 한 사람을 찾으시려고 계속 둘레를 둘러보셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서는 누가 자기를 만졌는지 알아보시려고 둘레에 있는 사람들을 계속 둘러보셨다.

es.L: Y miraba alrededor para ver a la que había hecho esto.
es.B: Pero Jesús seguía mirando a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor para descubrir a la que lo había hecho.
es.R: Pero Jesús seguía mirando a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodeaba para saber quién {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había tocado.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} regardait tout autour pour voir celle qui avait fait cela.
fr.B: Mais Jésus continuait à scruter les visages autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour voir celle qui avait fait cela.
fr.R: Mais Jésus continuait à regarder les gens autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour trouver qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait touché.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akitazama pande zote ili amwone [mwanamke] aliyefanya jambo hili.
sw.B: Lakini Yesu aliendelea kutazama nyuso za watu waliomzunguka, ili amwone yule aliyefanya hivyo.
sw.R: Lakini Yesu aliendelea kuwatazama watu waliomzunguka ili ajue ni nani aliyemgusa.

decisions.choice: the one who had done this: the participle is feminine
alternatives: Jesus knew she was a woman
decisions.reason: The Greek form is feminine. Mark the narrator knows it was a woman; it does not say whether Jesus did.

decisions.choice: was looking around: he kept looking
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: he did not give up searching.

decisions.choice: [woman]
decisions.reason: Literal shows the feminine form with a bracketed word.

decisions.choice: a la que (L, B), with no supplied [woman]
decisions.reason: Spanish shows the feminine of the Greek participle (meaning decision) in the article "la", so Literal needs no supplied word.

decisions.choice: celle qui avait fait cela
decisions.reason: The Greek participle is feminine (meaning decision m1). French "celle" shows the feminine by itself, so Literal needs no bracketed word, and Balanced keeps it too.

source.text: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ φοβηθεῖσα καὶ τρέμουσα, εἰδυῖα ὃ γέγονεν αὐτῇ, ἦλθεν καὶ προσέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

records.literal_gloss: The and woman, having been afraid and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before him and told him all the truth.

en.L: And the woman, frightened and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole truth.
en.B: Then the woman, afraid and shaking, knowing what had been done for her, came forward, dropped down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole truth.
en.R: The woman knew what had happened to her. She was afraid and shaking. She came and bowed down in front of Jesus. Then she told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole truth.

vi.L: Bấy giờ người phụ nữ sợ hãi và run rẩy, vì biết điều đã xảy ra cho mình, đến sấp mình trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tất cả sự thật.
vi.B: Người phụ nữ sợ hãi, run rẩy, vì biết việc đã xảy ra cho mình. Bà đến quỳ sụp trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và thưa hết mọi sự thật.
vi.R: Người phụ nữ biết việc đã xảy ra cho mình. Bà sợ hãi và run rẩy. Bà đến quỳ xuống trước mặt Đức Giê-xu và kể cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe hết mọi sự thật.

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자는 두려워하고 떨면서, 자기에게 일어난 일을 알기에, 와서 그분 앞에 엎드려 그분께 모든 사실을 말씀드렸다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 자기에게 일어난 일을 알고 있었으므로, 두려워 떨면서 나아와 예수 앞에 엎드려 사실을 모두 말씀드렸다.
ko.R: 여자는 자기에게 일어난 일을 알고 있었다. 그래서 무서워 떨었다. 여자는 예수께 나아와 그 앞에 엎드렸다. 그리고 있었던 일을 모두 사실대로 말씀드렸다.

es.L: Y la mujer, con miedo y temblando, sabiendo lo que le había sucedido, vino y se postró ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo toda la verdad.
es.B: Entonces la mujer, asustada y temblorosa, sabiendo lo que le había pasado, se acercó, se echó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contó toda la verdad.
es.R: La mujer sabía lo que le había pasado. Tenía miedo y temblaba. Se acercó y se arrodilló delante de Jesús. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contó toda la verdad.

fr.L: Mais la femme, effrayée et tremblante, sachant ce qui lui était arrivé, vint se jeter devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit toute la vérité.
fr.B: Alors la femme, saisie de crainte et toute tremblante, sachant ce qui s’était passé en elle, s’avança, tomba à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit toute la vérité.
fr.R: La femme savait ce qui lui était arrivé. Elle avait peur et elle tremblait. Elle est venue se mettre à genoux devant Jésus. Puis elle {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit toute la vérité.

sw.L: Lakini yule mwanamke, akiogopa na kutetemeka, akijua lililompata, alikuja akaanguka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akamwambia kweli yote.
sw.B: Ndipo yule mwanamke, akiwa na hofu na kutetemeka, akijua yaliyokuwa yamemtokea, alikuja akajitupa chini mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akamweleza kweli yote.
sw.R: Mwanamke yule alijua yaliyompata. Aliogopa na kutetemeka. Alikuja akapiga magoti mbele ya Yesu. Kisha akamweleza kweli yote.

decisions.choice: frightened and trembling: awe as well as fear
decisions.reason: She may have feared blame for touching him while unclean. The same words are used for awe before God's power.

decisions.choice: the whole truth: everything that had happened
decisions.reason: She tells her whole story openly, before the crowd.

decisions.choice: "사실" for aletheia here
decisions.reason: Here the word means everything that had happened (meaning decision), a plain fact; the style guide keeps the key term "진리" for the truth of God and uses "사실" for a plain fact.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Θυγάτηρ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε· ὕπαγε εἰς εἰρήνην, καὶ ἴσθι ὑγιὴς ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγός σου.

records.literal_gloss: He and said to her, Daughter, the faith of you has saved you; go in peace, and be healthy from the affliction of you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to her, "Daughter, your faith has saved you. Go in peace, and be healthy, [free] from your affliction."
en.B: "Daughter," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told her, "your faith has saved you and made you well. Go in peace, free of your suffering."
en.R: Jesus said to her, "My daughter, your faith has made you well and saved you. Go in peace. Your sickness is gone for good."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với bà: "Con gái, đức tin của con đã cứu con. Hãy đi bình an, và được lành mạnh, [khỏi] tai họa của con."
vi.B: Ngài nói với bà: "Con gái ơi, đức tin của con đã cứu con và làm cho con được lành. Hãy đi bình an, và được khỏi hẳn bệnh khổ của con."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với bà: "Con gái ơi, đức tin của con đã chữa lành con và cứu con. Hãy về bình an. Con đã khỏi bệnh hẳn rồi."

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 구원하였다. 평안히 가거라. 그리고 네 괴로운 병에서 [벗어나] 건강하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 구원하고 낫게 하였다. 평안히 가거라. 괴로운 병에서 벗어나 건강하게 지내라."
ko.R: 예수께서 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "내 딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 낫게 하고 구원하였다. 평안히 가거라. 네 병은 이제 다 나았다."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dijo: «Hija, tu fe te ha salvado; vete en paz, y queda sana de tu mal».
es.B: «Hija», le dijo, «tu fe te ha salvado y te ha sanado. Vete en paz, libre de tu sufrimiento».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Hija mía, tu fe te ha sanado y te ha salvado. Vete en paz. Ya estás sana de tu enfermedad para siempre».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Fille, ta foi t’a sauvée ; va en paix, et sois en bonne santé, [délivrée] de ton mal. »
fr.B: « Ma fille, lui dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}, ta foi t’a sauvée et guérie. Va en paix, délivrée de ton mal. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Ma fille, ta foi t’a guérie et t’a sauvée. Va en paix. Tu es guérie de ta maladie pour toujours. »

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Binti, imani yako imekuokoa. Nenda kwa amani, nawe uwe mzima, [huru] mbali na adha yako."
sw.B: Akamwambia, "Binti, imani yako imekuokoa na kukuponya. Nenda kwa amani, ukiwa huru kutoka katika mateso yako."
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia, "Binti yangu, imani yako imekuponya na kukuokoa. Nenda kwa amani. Ugonjwa wako umekwisha kabisa."

decisions.choice: has saved: has made well, and more
decisions.reason: The verb is the one she used in 5:28, which means both healing and rescue by God. Her body is healed already (5:29); Jesus' words also give her a place restored before God and the people.

decisions.choice: faith: trust in Jesus to heal
decisions.reason: Her faith is shown in what she did: reaching out to Jesus. Jesus credits her faith, not her touch or the cloak.

decisions.choice: go in peace: a farewell and blessing
decisions.reason: The words are a common Jewish farewell (1 Samuel 1:17). Peace means wholeness and well-being.

decisions.choice: daughter: a word of warmth and of welcome
decisions.reason: Jesus calls the unclean woman "daughter", taking her into the family of God's people (3:35).

decisions.choice: be healthy from your affliction: stay healed
decisions.reason: Jesus confirms that the cure is real and lasting.

decisions.choice: saved you and made you well (B); made you well and saved you (R)
decisions.reason: One English verb cannot carry both senses, so Balanced and Readable use two. Literal keeps the single verb.

decisions.choice: Jesus calls her "con gái" and "con", while the narrator says "bà"
decisions.reason: "Daughter" is a word of warmth and welcome (meaning decision). Vietnamese "con" is how an older person speaks tenderly to someone younger, and it keeps the Greek word; the narrator still calls her "bà".

decisions.choice: "딸아"; "믿음" for pistis; "평안히" for "in peace"
decisions.reason: "딸아" is warm and fits Jesus' plain style; "믿음" is the noun used in the Korean letters; "평안" is the key term for peace from the Korean John, here in its everyday adverb form for a farewell blessing.

decisions.choice: Hija mía
decisions.reason: "Daughter" here is a word of warmth and welcome (meaning decision); Readable adds "mía" so that it reads as tender, not as a bare form of address.

decisions.choice: Fille (L); Ma fille (B, R)
decisions.reason: A bare "Fille" sounds abrupt in French; "ma fille" is how French says the warm, welcoming address of meaning decision m4.

decisions.choice: imekuokoa (L); imekuokoa na kukuponya (B); imekuponya na kukuokoa (R)
decisions.reason: "Kuokoa" (save, rescue) is the verb Swahili uses for salvation, and "kuponya" (heal) for getting well. Literal keeps the one Greek verb as "kuokoa"; Balanced and Readable use both verbs, so that neither half of the meaning note is lost, as the English does.

source.text: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχονται ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγοντες ὅτι Ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ἀπέθανεν· τί ἔτι σκύλλεις τὸν διδάσκαλον;

records.literal_gloss: Still him speaking, they come from the synagogue leader saying that, The daughter of you died; why still trouble the teacher?

en.L: While {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still speaking, they come from the [house of the] synagogue leader, saying, "Your daughter has died. Why trouble the teacher any longer?"
en.B: While Jesus was still talking, some people arrived from the synagogue leader's house. "Your daughter is dead," they said. "There is no need to bother the teacher any more."
en.R: Jesus was still speaking when some people came from Jairus's house. They said to Jairus, "Your daughter has died. Do not make the teacher come now."

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, có người từ [nhà] người lãnh đạo nhà hội đến, nói rằng: "Con gái ông đã chết rồi; sao còn làm phiền Thầy nữa?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì có mấy người từ nhà ông lãnh đạo nhà hội đến báo: "Con gái ông chết rồi. Còn làm phiền Thầy làm gì nữa?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì có mấy người từ nhà Giai-ru đến. Họ nói với Giai-ru: "Con gái ông đã chết rồi. Đừng làm phiền Thầy nữa."

ko.L: 그분이 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 회당장의 [집]에서 사람들이 와서 말한다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 어찌하여 아직도 선생님을 수고롭게 하십니까?"
ko.B: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 회당장의 집에서 사람들이 와서 말했다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 이제 선생님을 더 수고롭게 하실 필요가 없습니다."
ko.R: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때, 야이로의 집에서 사람들이 왔다. 그들이 야이로에게 말했다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 이제 선생님을 모셔 오지 않으셔도 됩니다."

es.L: Estando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todavía hablando, vienen de [casa] del jefe de la sinagoga, diciendo: «Tu hija ha muerto; ¿para qué molestas todavía al Maestro?».
es.B: Mientras Jesús todavía estaba hablando, llegaron unos de la casa del jefe de la sinagoga. «Tu hija ha muerto», le dijeron. «No hace falta que sigas molestando al Maestro».
es.R: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegaron unas personas de la casa de Jairo. Le dijeron a Jairo: «Tu hija ya murió. No hagas venir al Maestro».

fr.L: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlait encore, [des gens] viennent de chez le chef de la synagogue, disant : « Ta fille est morte ; pourquoi déranges-tu encore le Maître ? »
fr.B: Il parlait encore quand des gens arrivèrent de la maison du chef de la synagogue : « Ta fille est morte, dirent-ils. Inutile de déranger davantage le Maître. »
fr.R: Jésus parlait encore quand des gens sont arrivés de la maison de Jaïre. Ils ont dit à Jaïre : « Ta fille est morte. Ce n’est plus la peine de déranger le Maître. »

sw.L: Alipokuwa bado akisema, wanakuja [watu] kutoka [nyumbani kwa] mkuu wa sinagogi, wakisema, "Binti yako amekufa; kwa nini kumsumbua mwalimu tena?"
sw.B: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, watu fulani walifika kutoka nyumbani kwa mkuu wa sinagogi. Wakasema, "Binti yako amekufa. Hakuna haja ya kuendelea kumsumbua mwalimu."
sw.R: Yesu alipokuwa bado akisema, watu walikuja kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo. Wakamwambia Yairo, "Binti yako amekufa. Usimsumbue mwalimu aje sasa."

decisions.choice: from the synagogue leader: from his house
decisions.reason: Jairus is with Jesus, so the messengers come from his household.

decisions.choice: why trouble the teacher any longer: it is too late
decisions.reason: The question means there is no point now. They expect nothing more.

decisions.choice: they come: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the chapter.

decisions.choice: They said to Jairus
decisions.reason: Readable names the one they speak to.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "the teacher"
decisions.reason: The messengers speak of Jesus by the title that Jairus used. Capitalised "Thầy" is the same word the disciples use for him, so the Greek word "teacher" stays recognisable.

decisions.choice: The messengers speak to Jairus in 합쇼체 and say "따님" for his daughter
decisions.reason: They are bringing word to the synagogue leader, a superior; Korean shows that respect with 합쇼체 and the honorific word for another person's daughter.

decisions.choice: el Maestro
decisions.reason: As in the Spanish of John (11:28): "Maestro", capitalised, when people speak of Jesus as their teacher.

decisions.choice: le Maître
decisions.reason: The Greek word means "teacher". French Bibles say "Maître" for this title of Jesus, as the French John does (11:28); the capital marks it as a title, so it is not read as "master" of a house.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς παρακούσας τὸν λόγον λαλούμενον λέγει τῷ ἀρχισυναγώγῳ· Μὴ φοβοῦ, μόνον πίστευε.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jesus, having overheard the word being spoken, says to the synagogue leader, Not fear, only believe.

en.L: But Jesus, overhearing the word being spoken, says to the synagogue leader, "Do not fear, only believe."
en.B: But Jesus paid no attention to what they said and told the synagogue leader, "Do not be afraid. Just believe."
en.R: Jesus heard what they said, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} paid no attention to it. He told Jairus, "Do not be afraid. Only believe."

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu, nghe được lời họ đang nói, nói với người lãnh đạo nhà hội: "Đừng sợ, chỉ hãy tin."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu không để ý đến lời họ nói, và bảo ông lãnh đạo nhà hội: "Ông đừng sợ, chỉ cần tin thôi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nghe họ nói, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để ý đến lời ấy. Ngài bảo Giai-ru: "Ông đừng sợ. Chỉ cần tin thôi."

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서는 [그들이] 하는 말을 곁에서 들으시고, 회당장에게 말씀하신다. "두려워하지 마라. 믿기만 하여라."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서는 그들이 하는 말에 아랑곳하지 않으시고 회당장에게 말씀하셨다. "두려워하지 마라. 계속 믿기만 하여라."
ko.R: 예수께서는 그들이 하는 말을 들으셨지만, 그 말에 마음을 쓰지 않으셨다. 예수께서 야이로에게 말씀하셨다. "무서워하지 마라. 믿기만 해라."

es.L: Pero Jesús, alcanzando a oír la palabra que se decía, dice al jefe de la sinagoga: «No temas; solo cree».
es.B: Pero Jesús no hizo caso de lo que decían, y le dijo al jefe de la sinagoga: «No tengas miedo. Solo cree».
es.R: Jesús oyó lo que decían, pero no les hizo caso. Le dijo a Jairo: «No tengas miedo. Solo sigue creyendo».

fr.L: Mais Jésus, ayant surpris la parole qui était dite, dit au chef de la synagogue : « Ne crains pas ; crois seulement. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus, sans tenir compte de ce qu’on disait, dit au chef de la synagogue : « N’aie pas peur. Crois seulement. »
fr.R: Jésus a entendu ce qu’ils disaient, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’y a pas fait attention. Il a dit à Jaïre : « N’aie pas peur. Crois seulement. »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akilisikia neno lililokuwa likisemwa, anamwambia mkuu wa sinagogi, "Usiogope, amini tu."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu hakujali maneno yale waliyosema, akamwambia mkuu wa sinagogi, "Usiogope. Amini tu."
sw.R: Yesu alisikia waliyosema, lakini hakuyajali. Akamwambia Yairo, "Usiogope. Endelea kuamini tu."

decisions.choice: overhearing: hearing and ignoring
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to overhear or to take no notice. Both fit: Jesus heard the message and set it aside.

decisions.choice: do not fear, only believe: keep on believing
decisions.reason: Both verbs are present commands: stop fearing, keep on believing. Fear is the opposite of faith in Mark (4:40).

decisions.choice: believe: trust Jesus even in the face of death
decisions.reason: Jairus is called to the same trust the woman showed (5:34).

decisions.choice: paid no attention to
decisions.reason: Balanced takes the sense of ignoring; Readable shows both. The footnote gives the other sense.

decisions.choice: Jesus says "ông" to Jairus (B, R)
decisions.reason: A Vietnamese command to a respected older man sounds abrupt without a word of address. "Ông" fits the synagogue leader; the Greek command has no pronoun, so Literal leaves it out.

decisions.choice: "곁에서 들으시고" (L); "아랑곳하지 않으시고" (B); "들으셨지만 마음을 쓰지 않으셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb can mean overhear or ignore (meaning decision, footnoted). Literal keeps "overhear"; Balanced and Readable say that he heard and paid no attention, as the English does.

decisions.choice: alcanzando a oír
decisions.reason: The verb means both overhearing and ignoring (meaning decision); Literal says "alcanzar a oír", Spanish for overhearing, while Balanced and Readable say that he paid no attention, as the English does.

decisions.choice: sigue creyendo
decisions.reason: The Greek command means to keep on believing (meaning decision); Readable says so, as plain Spanish allows.

decisions.choice: ayant surpris (L)
decisions.reason: The verb can mean either overhearing or refusing to listen (meaning decision m1, with its footnote). French "surprendre une parole" means to overhear, the first sense; Balanced and Readable give the second, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν οὐδένα μετ’ αὐτοῦ συνακολουθῆσαι εἰ μὴ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ἰακώβου.

records.literal_gloss: And not he permitted anyone with him to follow except the Peter and James and John the brother of James.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not permit anyone to follow along with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} except Peter and James and John the brother of James.
en.B: He would not let anyone come with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} except Peter, James, and James's brother John.
en.R: Jesus let only Peter, James, and John go with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. John was James's brother.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho phép ai đi theo cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ngoại trừ Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ, và Giăng, anh em của Gia-cơ.
vi.B: Ngài không cho ai đi cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ngoại trừ Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng, anh em của Gia-cơ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu chỉ cho Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Giăng là anh em của Gia-cơ.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 베드로와 야고보와 야고보의 형제 요한 외에는 아무도 자기와 함께 따라오는 것을 허락하지 않으셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 베드로와 야고보와 야고보의 형제 요한 외에는 아무도 따라오지 못하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 베드로와 야고보와 요한만 함께 가게 하셨다. 요한은 야고보의 형제였다.

es.L: Y no permitió a nadie acompañarlo, excepto a Pedro y a Santiago y a Juan, el hermano de Santiago.
es.B: No dejó que nadie fuera con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, excepto Pedro, Santiago y Juan, el hermano de Santiago.
es.R: Jesús solo dejó que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} acompañaran Pedro, Santiago y Juan. Juan era hermano de Santiago.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne permit à personne de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagner, sinon Pierre et Jacques et Jean, le frère de Jacques.
fr.B: Il ne laissa personne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagner, sauf Pierre, Jacques et Jean, le frère de Jacques.
fr.R: Jésus a laissé seulement Pierre, Jacques et Jean venir avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Jean était le frère de Jacques.

sw.L: Wala hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kufuatana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} isipokuwa Petro na Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo.
sw.B: Hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kwenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo, na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo.
sw.R: Yesu aliwaruhusu Petro, Yakobo na Yohana tu kwenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Yohana alikuwa ndugu yake Yakobo.

decisions.choice: Peter, James and John: the inner group of disciples
decisions.reason: These three also see the transfiguration (9:2) and are near Jesus in Gethsemane (14:33).

decisions.choice: "anh em"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese names a brother as older ("anh") or younger ("em"). The Greek does not say which John was, so the general "anh em" is used, as for Andrew in the Vietnamese John (1:40).

decisions.choice: Santiago
decisions.reason: As in the Spanish of Galatians and James: "Santiago" is the usual Spanish name for the men called James.

source.text: καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου, καὶ θεωρεῖ θόρυβον καὶ κλαίοντας καὶ ἀλαλάζοντας πολλά, καὶ εἰσελθὼν λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τί θορυβεῖσθε καὶ κλαίετε;

records.literal_gloss: And they come to the house of the synagogue leader, and he sees a commotion and weeping and wailing much, \v 39 and having gone in he says to them, Why are you making commotion and weeping?

en.L: And they come to the house of the synagogue leader, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees a commotion, and [people] weeping and wailing loudly, \v 39 and going in, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them, "Why are you making a commotion and weeping?
en.B: When they reached the synagogue leader's house, Jesus saw an uproar, with people crying and howling in grief. \v 39 He went in and asked them, "Why all this noise and crying?
en.R: They came to the house of Jairus. Jesus saw that there was a lot of noise and confusion. People were crying loudly. Some were wailing for the dead girl. \v 39 Jesus went inside and said to them, "Why are you making all this noise? Why are you crying?

vi.L: Và họ đến nhà người lãnh đạo nhà hội, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy cảnh ồn ào, [người ta] khóc lóc và kêu than rất nhiều, \v 39 và bước vào, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao các người om sòm và khóc lóc?
vi.B: Khi đến nhà ông lãnh đạo nhà hội, Đức Giê-xu thấy cảnh hỗn loạn, người ta khóc lóc và than van ầm ĩ. \v 39 Ngài bước vào và hỏi họ: "Sao các người lại náo động và khóc lóc như vậy?
vi.R: Họ đến nhà Giai-ru. Đức Giê-xu thấy cảnh ồn ào, rối loạn. Người ta đang khóc lóc rất to. Có người kêu than cho đứa bé đã chết. \v 39 Đức Giê-xu đi vào trong và nói với họ: "Sao các người làm ồn như vậy? Sao các người khóc?

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 회당장의 집으로 온다. 그리고 그분은 소란스러운 것과, [사람들이] 울며 크게 통곡하는 것을 보신다. \v 39 그리고 들어가셔서 그들에게 말씀하신다. "어찌하여 소란을 피우며 울고 있느냐?
ko.B: 그들이 회당장의 집에 이르렀을 때, 예수께서는 사람들이 소란스럽게 울며 큰 소리로 통곡하는 것을 보셨다. \v 39 예수께서 안으로 들어가셔서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 이렇게 떠들며 울고 있느냐?
ko.R: 그들은 야이로의 집에 왔다. 예수께서 보시니, 그 집은 아주 시끄럽고 어수선했다. 사람들이 큰 소리로 울고 있었다. 죽은 아이 때문에 슬피 통곡하는 사람들도 있었다. \v 39 예수께서 안으로 들어가셔서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 이렇게 소란스럽게 하느냐? 왜 울고 있느냐?

es.L: Y llegan a la casa del jefe de la sinagoga, y ve un alboroto, y a los que lloraban y daban grandes alaridos; \v 39 y entrando, les dice: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:alborotan|alborotáis}} y {{plural_you:lloran|lloráis}}?
es.B: Cuando llegaron a la casa del jefe de la sinagoga, Jesús vio el alboroto y a la gente que lloraba y gritaba de dolor. \v 39 Entró y les dijo: «¿Por qué tanto alboroto y tanto llanto?
es.R: Llegaron a la casa de Jairo. Jesús vio que había mucho ruido y confusión. La gente lloraba a gritos. Algunos se lamentaban por la niña muerta. \v 39 Jesús entró y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} tanto ruido? ¿Por qué {{plural_you:lloran|lloráis}}?

fr.L: Et ils arrivent à la maison du chef de la synagogue, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit de l’agitation, et [des gens] qui pleurent et poussent de grands cris, \v 39 et étant entré, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pourquoi vous agitez-vous et pleurez-vous ?
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à la maison du chef de la synagogue, Jésus vit tout un tumulte : des gens pleuraient et se lamentaient à grands cris. \v 39 Il entra et leur dit : « Pourquoi tout ce bruit et ces pleurs ?
fr.R: Ils sont arrivés à la maison de Jaïre. Jésus a vu qu’il y avait beaucoup de bruit et d’agitation. Les gens pleuraient très fort. Certains poussaient des cris de deuil pour la fillette morte. \v 39 Jésus est entré et leur a dit : « Pourquoi faites-vous tout ce bruit ? Pourquoi pleurez-vous ?

sw.L: Nao wanafika nyumbani kwa mkuu wa sinagogi, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anaona ghasia, na [watu] wakilia na kuomboleza sana, \v 39 na akiisha kuingia anawaambia, "Mbona mnafanya ghasia na kulia?
sw.B: Walipofika nyumbani kwa mkuu wa sinagogi, Yesu aliona ghasia, watu wakilia na kuomboleza kwa sauti kubwa. \v 39 Akaingia ndani, akawauliza, "Kwa nini makelele haya yote na kilio hiki?
sw.R: Walifika nyumbani kwa Yairo. Yesu aliona kuna kelele nyingi na fujo. Watu walikuwa wakilia kwa sauti kubwa. Wengine walikuwa wakiomboleza kwa ajili ya msichana aliyekufa. \v 39 Yesu aliingia ndani, akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnapiga kelele hivi? Kwa nini mnalia?

decisions.choice: commotion, weeping and wailing: the loud mourning that followed a death
decisions.reason: Mourning began at once and was loud. Families hired flute players and mourning women (Matthew 9:23; Jeremiah 9:17).

decisions.choice: he sees: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the chapter, Mark tells the story in the present tense.

decisions.choice: reached, saw, asked; came, saw, said
alternatives: they come, he sees, he says
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the past tense.

decisions.choice: Some were wailing for the dead girl
decisions.reason: Readable says why they were wailing.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the mourners
decisions.reason: The style guide's form of address for Jesus speaking to a crowd. It is neither warm nor rude, as the scene needs.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the mourners, so each plural "you" verb is the reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain). Balanced asks without a verb. This applies throughout the chapter.

source.text: τὸ παιδίον οὐκ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει.

records.literal_gloss: The child not died but sleeps.

en.L: The child has not died but is sleeping."
en.B: The child is not dead. She is asleep."
en.R: The girl is not dead. She is only sleeping."

vi.L: Đứa trẻ không chết, nhưng đang ngủ."
vi.B: Đứa bé không chết đâu, chỉ đang ngủ thôi."
vi.R: Cô bé không chết đâu. Cô bé chỉ đang ngủ thôi."

ko.L: 그 아이는 죽은 것이 아니라 자고 있다."
ko.B: 아이는 죽은 것이 아니라 잠들어 있다."
ko.R: 그 여자아이는 죽지 않았다. 그냥 자고 있을 뿐이다."

es.L: La niña no ha muerto, sino que duerme».
es.B: La niña no está muerta. Está dormida».
es.R: La niña no está muerta. Solo está dormida».

fr.L: L’enfant n’est pas morte, mais elle dort. »
fr.B: L’enfant n’est pas morte : elle est endormie. »
fr.R: La fillette n’est pas morte. Elle dort, c’est tout. »

sw.L: Mtoto hajafa, bali amelala."
sw.B: Mtoto hajafa. Amelala tu."
sw.R: Msichana huyu hajafa. Amelala usingizi tu."

decisions.choice: sleeps: her death will be like a sleep from which she wakes
decisions.reason: The messengers and mourners know she has died (5:35, 40). Jesus speaks of death as a sleep that he will end, as in John 11:11-14.

decisions.choice: the girl
decisions.reason: Readable names her as a girl, as 5:41 does.

decisions.choice: la fillette (R narration and here)
decisions.reason: She is twelve (5:42), so Readable calls her "la fillette"; "ma petite fille" is kept in her father’s mouth (5:23), where it renders his affectionate diminutive.

source.text: καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And they were laughing at him.

en.L: And they were laughing at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: They laughed at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: The people laughed at Jesus.

vi.L: Và họ chế nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ cười nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mọi người cười nhạo Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 그분을 비웃고 있었다.
ko.B: 사람들은 예수를 비웃었다.
ko.R: 사람들은 예수를 보고 비웃었다.

es.L: Y se reían de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Se burlaron de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: La gente se burló de Jesús.

fr.L: Et ils se moquaient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Ils se moquèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Les gens se sont moqués de Jésus.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakimcheka.
sw.B: Wakamcheka kwa dharau.
sw.R: Watu wakamcheka Yesu.

decisions.choice: laughing at: mocking with scorn
decisions.reason: The verb means to laugh someone down. They know she is dead.

source.text: αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκβαλὼν πάντας παραλαμβάνει τὸν πατέρα τοῦ παιδίου καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τοὺς μετ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἰσπορεύεται ὅπου ἦν τὸ παιδίον·

records.literal_gloss: He but having put out all takes the father of the child and the mother and those with him, and goes in where was the child.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, putting them all out, takes the child's father and mother and those with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and goes in where the child was.
en.B: But Jesus sent them all outside. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took the disciples who were with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and the child's father and mother, and went into the room where the girl lay.
en.R: But Jesus made all the people go outside. He took the girl's father and mother and the three followers who were with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They went into the room where the girl was lying.

vi.L: Nhưng chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sau khi đuổi hết mọi người ra, dẫn cha mẹ đứa trẻ và những người đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, rồi đi vào nơi đứa trẻ ở.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu bảo mọi người ra ngoài hết. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn cha mẹ đứa bé và các môn đồ đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào phòng đứa bé nằm.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu bắt mọi người ra ngoài. Ngài dẫn cha mẹ cô bé và ba môn đồ đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào phòng cô bé đang nằm.

ko.L: 그러나 그분은 모두를 밖으로 내보내시고, 아이의 아버지와 어머니와 자기와 함께 있는 이들을 데리고, 아이가 있는 곳으로 들어가신다.
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서는 사람들을 모두 밖으로 내보내셨다. 그리고 함께 온 제자들과 아이의 아버지와 어머니를 데리고, 아이가 누워 있는 방으로 들어가셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서는 사람들을 모두 밖으로 내보내셨다. 그리고 아이의 아버지와 어머니, 함께 온 세 제자를 데리고 아이가 누워 있는 방으로 들어가셨다.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, echándolos fuera a todos, toma al padre de la niña y a la madre y a los que estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y entra adonde estaba la niña.
es.B: Pero Jesús hizo salir a todos. Luego tomó consigo al padre y a la madre de la niña, y a los discípulos que estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y entró adonde estaba la niña.
es.R: Pero Jesús hizo salir a toda la gente. Tomó al padre y a la madre de la niña, y a los tres discípulos que estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entraron en el cuarto donde estaba la niña.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, les ayant tous mis dehors, prend le père de l’enfant et la mère et ceux qui étaient avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et entre là où était l’enfant.
fr.B: Mais Jésus les fit tous sortir. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le père et la mère de l’enfant, ainsi que les disciples qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagnaient, et entra dans la pièce où se trouvait l’enfant.
fr.R: Mais Jésus a fait sortir tout le monde. Il a pris avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le père et la mère de la fillette, et les trois disciples qui étaient avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Ils sont entrés dans la pièce où la fillette était couchée.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, akiisha kuwatoa wote nje, anawachukua baba wa mtoto na mama na wale waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, na anaingia mahali alipokuwa mtoto.
sw.B: Lakini Yesu aliwatoa wote nje. Kisha akawachukua wanafunzi waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, na baba na mama wa mtoto, akaingia chumbani alimokuwa amelala msichana.
sw.R: Lakini Yesu aliwaamuru watu wote watoke nje. Akawachukua baba na mama wa msichana, na wale wanafunzi watatu waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Wakaingia chumbani alimokuwa amelala msichana.

decisions.choice: putting out: sending out firmly
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for driving out spirits, but here it means to make people leave.

decisions.choice: those with him: Peter, James and John (5:37)
decisions.reason: Only these three disciples came with him to the house.

decisions.choice: the disciples (B); the three followers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who they were, from 5:37.

source.text: καὶ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ παιδίου λέγει αὐτῇ· Ταλιθα κουμ, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον· Τὸ κοράσιον, σοὶ λέγω, ἔγειρε.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken hold of the hand of the child he says to her, Talitha koum, which is being translated, Little girl, to you I say, get up.

en.L: And taking hold of the child's hand, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to her, "Talitha koum," which is translated, "Little girl, I say to you, get up."
en.B: He took the child by the hand and said to her, "Talitha koum," which means, "Little girl, I tell you, get up."
en.R: Jesus took the girl's hand and said to her, "Talitha koum." These words mean, "Little girl, I am telling you to get up!"

vi.L: Và nắm lấy tay đứa trẻ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với cô bé: "Ta-li-tha cum", dịch ra là: "Hỡi bé gái, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với con, hãy trỗi dậy!"
vi.B: Ngài nắm tay đứa bé và nói: "Ta-li-tha cum", nghĩa là: "Bé gái ơi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bảo con, hãy trỗi dậy!"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cầm tay cô bé và nói: "Ta-li-tha cum". Câu này có nghĩa là: "Bé gái ơi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bảo con: hãy đứng dậy!"

ko.L: 그리고 아이의 손을 잡으시고 그 아이에게 말씀하신다. "달리다 굼." 이것을 번역하면 "소녀야, 내가 너에게 말한다. 일어나라"이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 아이의 손을 잡으시고 말씀하셨다. "달리다 굼!" 그것은 "소녀야, 내가 너에게 말한다. 일어나라!"라는 뜻이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 아이의 손을 잡으시고 말씀하셨다. "달리다 굼!" 이 말은 "얘야, 내가 말한다. 일어나라!"라는 뜻이다.

es.L: Y tomando la mano de la niña, le dice: «Talita kum», que traducido es: «Niña, a ti te digo, levántate».
es.B: Tomó a la niña de la mano y le dijo: «Talita kum», que significa: «Niña, te digo, ¡levántate!».
es.R: Jesús tomó la mano de la niña y le dijo: «Talita kum». Estas palabras quieren decir: «¡Niña, te digo que te levantes!».

fr.L: Et prenant la main de l’enfant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Talitha koum », ce qui se traduit : « Fillette, je te le dis, lève-toi. »
fr.B: Il prit l’enfant par la main et lui dit : « Talitha koum », ce qui signifie : « Jeune fille, je te le dis, lève-toi ! »
fr.R: Jésus a pris la main de la fillette et lui a dit : « Talitha koum. » Ces mots veulent dire : « Petite fille, je te le dis : lève-toi ! »

sw.L: Na akimshika mtoto mkono, anamwambia, "Talitha kum," maana yake ikitafsiriwa, "Msichana, nakuambia, amka."
sw.B: Akamshika mtoto mkono, akamwambia, "Talitha kum," maana yake, "Msichana, nakuambia, amka."
sw.R: Yesu akamshika msichana mkono, akamwambia, "Talitha kum." Maneno hayo yanamaanisha, "Msichana, nakuambia uamke!"

decisions.choice: Talitha koum: Aramaic words, kept and translated by Mark
decisions.reason: Aramaic was the everyday language of Jesus and his people. Mark keeps his very words and translates them for Greek readers (7:34; 14:36).

decisions.choice: get up: rise, a word also used for rising from death
decisions.reason: The verb is ordinary, for getting up from bed, but it is also used for being raised from the dead (16:6).

decisions.choice: I say to you: Mark adds these words to the translation
decisions.reason: The Aramaic is only "little girl, get up". The added words stress the authority of Jesus' command.

decisions.choice: Talitha koum, written in English letters
alternatives: little girl, arise, without the Aramaic
decisions.reason: All levels keep the Aramaic words as Mark does, since he translates them himself.

decisions.choice: "Ta-li-tha cum", in Vietnamese syllables
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Aramaic words and translates them (meaning decision), so they stay untranslated here and are written as Vietnamese spells foreign words. The spelling follows the SBLGNT form "koum"; "cu-mi" reflects a longer variant form.

decisions.choice: "trỗi dậy" (L, B); "đứng dậy" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is also used for rising from death (meaning decision). "Trỗi dậy" carries both senses, getting up and rising; Readable uses the everyday "đứng dậy".

decisions.choice: "달리다 굼" in Hangul; "소녀야" (L, B), "얘야" (R) for the little girl
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Aramaic and translates it (meaning decision); Korean writes the words in Hangul in their established Protestant form, spaced as two words. Readable uses the everyday way of calling a child.

decisions.choice: Talita kum
decisions.reason: The Aramaic words (meaning decision) written in Spanish spelling, as the English writes them in English letters; Mark's own translation follows them.

decisions.choice: lève-toi
