decisions.reason: The verb is the one also used for rising from death (meaning decision m2); French "se lever" is the everyday word for getting up and is also used of rising again, so every level keeps it. 5:42 "se leva" answers it.

decisions.choice: Talitha kum
decisions.reason: The Aramaic words are written in Swahili spelling, where "u" already has the sound the English spelling writes "ou".

decisions.choice: amka
decisions.reason: "Amka" (wake up, get up) answers "amelala" (she is sleeping) in 5:39, and is also used of rising from death, which suits the meaning note. "Inuka" (get up) would lose the link with sleep.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέστη τὸ κοράσιον καὶ περιεπάτει, ἦν γὰρ ἐτῶν δώδεκα.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately rose up the girl and was walking around; she was for of years twelve.

en.L: And immediately the girl got up and was walking around; for she was twelve years [old].
en.B: At once the girl stood up and walked about, for she was twelve years old.
en.R: Right away the girl stood up and started walking around. She was twelve years old.

vi.L: Và lập tức cô bé đứng dậy và đi lại; vì cô đã mười hai tuổi.
vi.B: Cô bé liền đứng dậy và đi lại được, vì cô đã mười hai tuổi.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức cô bé đứng dậy và bắt đầu đi lại. Cô bé đã mười hai tuổi.

ko.L: 그러자 곧 소녀가 일어나서 걸어 다녔다. 그 아이가 열두 살이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 곧바로 소녀가 일어나 걸어 다녔다. 소녀는 열두 살이었다.
ko.R: 바로 소녀가 일어나 걸어 다니기 시작했다. 소녀는 열두 살이었다.

es.L: Y enseguida la niña se levantó y andaba, porque tenía doce años.
es.B: Al instante la niña se puso de pie y empezó a caminar, pues tenía doce años.
es.R: Enseguida la niña se puso de pie y empezó a caminar. Tenía doce años.

fr.L: Et aussitôt la jeune fille se leva, et elle marchait ; car elle avait douze ans.
fr.B: Aussitôt la jeune fille se leva et se mit à marcher, car elle avait douze ans.
fr.R: Tout de suite, la fillette s’est levée et elle s’est mise à marcher. Elle avait douze ans.

sw.L: Na mara moja msichana akasimama, akawa akitembea; kwa maana alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili.
sw.B: Mara moja msichana akasimama, akaanza kutembea, kwa kuwa alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili.
sw.R: Mara hiyo msichana alisimama, akaanza kutembea huku na huku. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili.

decisions.choice: for she was twelve years old: explains why she could walk
alternatives: explains why she was called a little girl
decisions.reason: The "for" explains that she was not a baby but old enough to walk. Her twelve years echo the woman's twelve years of illness (5:25).

decisions.choice: got up: rose
decisions.reason: She rises at Jesus' word. The same verb is used for rising from death (8:31).

source.text: καὶ ἐξέστησαν εὐθὺς ἐκστάσει μεγάλῃ.

records.literal_gloss: And they were amazed immediately with amazement great.

en.L: And immediately they were overcome with great amazement.
en.B: Everyone was astounded on the spot.
en.R: Her parents and the followers were completely amazed.

vi.L: Và lập tức họ kinh ngạc, một sự kinh ngạc lớn.
vi.B: Mọi người đều sửng sốt ngay lúc ấy.
vi.R: Cha mẹ cô bé và các môn đồ vô cùng kinh ngạc.

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 곧 큰 놀라움에 사로잡혔다.
ko.B: 사람들은 그 자리에서 몹시 놀랐다.
ko.R: 소녀의 부모와 제자들은 너무나 놀랐다.

es.L: Y enseguida se asombraron con gran asombro.
es.B: Todos se quedaron atónitos en ese mismo momento.
es.R: Sus padres y los discípulos se quedaron muy asombrados.

fr.L: Et aussitôt ils furent saisis d’une grande stupeur.
fr.B: Tous furent sur-le-champ frappés de stupeur.
fr.R: Ses parents et les disciples ont été complètement stupéfaits.

sw.L: Na mara moja wakashangaa kwa mshangao mkuu.
sw.B: Wote waliokuwapo wakashangaa mno papo hapo.
sw.R: Wazazi wake na wale wanafunzi walishangaa sana.

decisions.choice: amazed with great amazement: utterly astonished
decisions.reason: Greek repeats the root of the verb in the noun to make it stronger. The word means to be beside oneself.

decisions.choice: Her parents and the followers
decisions.reason: Readable names who was in the room (5:40).

decisions.choice: "kinh ngạc, một sự kinh ngạc lớn" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the noun after the verb so the reader sees the Greek's "amazed with great amazement" (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say it as one strong phrase.

decisions.choice: se asombraron con gran asombro
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek doubling of verb and noun (meaning decision), which Spanish can bear; Balanced and Readable say "atónitos" and "muy asombrados".

source.text: καὶ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς πολλὰ ἵνα μηδεὶς γνοῖ τοῦτο, καὶ εἶπεν δοθῆναι αὐτῇ φαγεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And he ordered them much that no one should know this, and he said to be given to her to eat.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said [that something] should be given to her to eat.
en.B: Jesus gave them strict orders not to let anyone find out about this, and said she should be given food.
en.R: Jesus told them firmly, "Do not let anyone know about this." Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them to give her some food.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiêm dặn họ đừng để ai biết điều này, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo đưa [đồ] cho cô bé ăn.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nghiêm dặn họ không được để ai biết việc này, rồi bảo họ cho cô bé ăn.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu căn dặn họ: "Đừng cho ai biết việc này." Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo họ cho cô bé ăn.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 아무도 이 일을 알지 못하게 하라고 그들에게 엄하게 명령하시고, 그 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 이 일을 아무에게도 알리지 말라고 그들에게 단단히 이르시고, 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 엄하게 말씀하셨다. "이 일을 아무에게도 알리지 마라." 그리고 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 하셨다.

es.L: Y les ordenó mucho que nadie supiera esto, y dijo que se le diera de comer.
es.B: Jesús les ordenó estrictamente que no dejaran que nadie se enterara de esto, y les dijo que le dieran de comer a la niña.
es.R: Jesús les dijo con firmeza: «No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie se entere de esto». Luego les dijo que le dieran algo de comer.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna avec insistance que personne ne le sache, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit [qu’on] lui donne à manger.
fr.B: Jésus leur recommanda vivement de ne laisser personne l’apprendre, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit de lui donner à manger.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit avec force : « Ne laissez personne l’apprendre. » Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a dit de lui donner à manger.

sw.L: Naye akawaagiza sana kwamba mtu yeyote asijue jambo hili, akasema apewe [kitu] ale.
sw.B: Yesu aliwapa amri kali wasimruhusu mtu yeyote kujua habari hii, akasema apewe chakula.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia kwa nguvu, "Msimwambie mtu yeyote habari hii." Kisha akawaambia wampe msichana chakula.

decisions.choice: no one should know this: Jesus keeps his work hidden
alternatives: he wanted the girl to rest
decisions.reason: As in 1:44 and 3:12, Jesus forbids spreading the news. The mourners outside would soon learn she was alive, but how it happened was to stay with these few.

decisions.choice: to be given to her to eat: a practical command
decisions.reason: She is fully alive and needs food, like anyone else.

decisions.choice: direct speech: Do not let anyone know about this
alternatives: that no one should know this
decisions.reason: Readable turns the order into direct speech.
